content:
**Unyielding** is a first star armor legendary mod in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Milepost Zero* update.

## Effects[]

The effect provides bonus to all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats (except Endurance). Max effect of +3 is achieved at 19.99% hp. The effect does not provide any bonuses when at or above 60%. The effect looks at exact health values, so it is possible for it to give fractional bonus, for example at 19.995% hp player gets +2.5 bonus.

| ![FO76 Unyielding Bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/7/75/FO76_Unyielding_Bonus.png) | 
| HP | Bonus | 
| 0% | +3 | 
| 19.99% | +3 | 
| 20% | +2 | 
| 39.99% | +2 | 
| 40% | +1 | 
| 59.99% | +1 | 
| 60% | +0 | 
| 100% | +0 |

## Locations[]

- Can drop as a random effect on any legendary armor.
- Mod boxes have a 1.5% chance to be received from scrapping a Unyielding legendary item.
- Can be crafted at a tinker's workbench once learned.
 - Crafting has a 1% chance to be unlocked from scrapping a Unyielding legendary item.
- Can be traded.

## Notes[]

- This mod can be applied to gear with armor workbench.
- The item from which the mod was learned does not matter. The learned mod can be applied to any armor.
